summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the poll results of its annual general meeting held on June 12, 2026. The filing discloses that all ordinary and special resolutions were passed, including the adoption of financial statements, re-election of directors, re-appointment of auditor, and share issuance/repurchase mandates. The results show overwhelming approval with over 98% votes in favor for each resolution. There are no extraordinary events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes; this is a routine corporate governance update. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
